title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Replace hardcoded protocol dispatch with table lookup
description:
Replace the inline if/else protocol-to-dissector mapping in
nettrace_msg_to_packet() with a data-driven protocol_mapping_t table
and a lookup function.

This makes adding new protocol mappings a one-line table entry instead
of modifying branching logic. The table supports matching on protocol,
function, and message name fields from the XML trace, with both direct
dissector name and dissector table dispatch modes.

Protocols added: ngap, s1ap, x2ap, xnap, f1ap, e1ap, pfcp, ranap,
nbap, rnsap, rrc, diameter, gtp.

Bump MAX_PROTO_LEN 16->32 and MAX_DTBL_LEN 32->64 for safety margin.

Unknown protocols now fall through for best-effort dissection instead
of returning an error.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
